optimizedDescription.value: Composes lifecycle-managed graph facade, backends, indexing, isolation, traversal, search, and curated public API.

optimizedContext.value:
# Composition

## Rules

- `CodeGraphProvider`: lifecycle-managed facade. `index(options)` with `force: true` clears logical contents and reprocesses every selected input; MUST NOT physically recreate storage. `clear()` removes logical contents from open reusable store. `recreate()` physically recovers storage only while closed; open call rejects typed precondition; success leaves closed. `open()` parameterless, reports typed recoverable corruption/schema error, never recreates implicitly. `close()` idempotent and settles outstanding requests before shutdown.
- Queries, exact batches, search, traversal, impact, selectors, coverage, statistics delegate to store/services. Composite operation performs one availability/staleness validation before bounded fan-out. `getSpec` returns `undefined` when absent.
- Factory overloads: `createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?: CodeGraphCompositionOptions)` derives storage root; `createCodeGraphProvider(options: CodeGraphOptions)` requires `storagePath`. Both select `options.graphStoreId ?? "sqlite"`, merge built-in `sqlite` plus additive `graphStoreFactories`, reject `sqlite` collision/unknown id, create one `GraphStore`, register TypeScript/Python/Go/PHP plus additive adapters, wire `IndexCodeGraph`.
- `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory()` accepts `SqliteGraphStoreFactoryOptions`, including serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`. Factory/provider creation synchronous; native loading, worker startup, schema preparation, generation checks during `open()`.
- `CodeGraphProvider` type-only; concrete provider, `GraphStore`, worker protocol, raw locks, `IndexCodeGraph` inputs internal. Callers construct only through `createCodeGraphProvider(...)`.
- Public `.` exports curated composition/types, `runIsolatedGraphIndex` host contracts/errors, host use cases, config/fingerprint helpers, index/discovery types, traversal/impact/hotspot/search APIs, language/model vocabulary, public errors including `GraphStorageRecoveryRequiredError`, `GraphStoreRecreateRequiresClosedError`, busy/isolated-worker failures, `CODE_GRAPH_VERSION`. No concrete stores, raw IPC/locks, launchers, child implementation, recreation helpers, or test seams.
- `./internal` exposes development internals. Published package includes stable built ESM isolated-worker child resolved from installed module location, not public host-selectable export.
- Hosts explicitly open/reuse/close provider; helpers such as `withOpenGraphProvider` may manage lifecycle. Long-lived hosts remain non-blocking and host-controlled.
- Host use cases receive open provider: `GetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage`. Search/hotspots/impact/traversal remain provider methods.
- Symbol-reference surface supports single/batch resolution, exact public-binding lookup, canonical/public-binding impact, unique/ambiguous/missing results. Unqualified selectors: case-exact, then case-insensitive exact; never prefix/text widening; bounded candidates. Invalid host selectors use typed `INVALID_GRAPH_SELECTOR`. Candidate enrichment uses one exact batch lookup.
- Unified search accepts query, `symbols | files | specs | documents`, filters, per-category limit, snippets. Normalize exact file filters; retain wildcard patterns. Shared use case expands, searches, locates occurrences, suppresses only symbol-covered ranges, groups/ranks, then limits. Exact single-file search retains every occurrence. Delivery adapters MUST NOT reimplement merge/dedup/limits.
- Runtime dependency `@specd/core`; configuration used only for composition. Workspace targets/spec sources supplied per `IndexOptions`.

## Constraints

- One selected `GraphStore`; registry-driven backend; default/built-in only `sqlite`.
- Explicit lifecycle; no auto-open/close or implicit recreation.
- Facade owns lifecycle, availability, locks, destructive recovery; delegates domain logic.
- Public construction only `createCodeGraphProvider`; internals only `./internal`; `LanguageAdapter` public.
